arguments.description: A single heavy industrial fortress main forge hall as a detailed fantasy game pixel-art building sprite. Steep charcoal-black roof with uneven ridges, thick soot-darkened brick and stone walls, iron-framed windows, large orange-glowing furnace mouth, reinforced front doors, exposed copper pipes, one massive side chimney, iron gantry and visible mechanical hammer silhouette. Dense asymmetrical functional structure with clear coal-black, rusty metal and glowing furnace contrast. Separate mine mountain, cooling basin, workshops and other chimneys will be independent assets. Shallow three-quarter view with roof and front visible, warm upper-left light, crisp selective outline, deliberate readable pixel clusters, controlled soot/iron/copper palette. One isolated building on transparent background, no scenery or cast shadow, clear border and front-foot ground anchor.
